free_tier.stated: Start free with 5,000 credits (USD 1) and no card to start; the Standard 7-day trial grants 50,000 credits (USD 10) but requires adding a card, and converts to USD 20 a month unless cancelled before day 7.
free_tier.notes: 5,000 credits are the free starting balance, not a recurring monthly allowance. A computer is billed per second on provisioned vCPU and memory; a session's 1 vCPU / 1 GiB computer costs 333 credits (USD 0.0666) per running hour, and a 2 vCPU / 4 GiB computer costs USD 0.1656 an hour at published rates.

per_object_cap.stated: The unit is a microVM, not an object. A session's computer is 1 vCPU / 1 GiB; one created directly defaults to 2 vCPU / 4096 MiB, with a range of 1 to 16 vCPU and 128 to 65536 MiB, disk up to 100 GiB.

retention.stated: A computer is disposable: state is ephemeral by default and a destroy tears it down. A snapshot is a durable checkpoint that survives destroy, a persistent volume keeps disk and paused memory across park and sleep but not destroy, and files that must outlive the sandbox are published to Files.

egress.terms: A computer has general outbound access by default with cloud metadata and internal ranges filtered; allow_outbound: false is an immutable kill-switch for all outbound traffic. Nothing reaches in: there is no port-preview surface. No egress price or volume allowance is published.

interface_detail: A TypeScript SDK (@usenaive-sdk/managed-agents) and a CLI (naive computer create/exec/fs/snapshot/pause/delete) against the API base URL https://api.vetta.sh with an API key.
tooling: The naive CLI and TypeScript SDK create and drive computers; a session's agent reaches the same machine through built-in shell, filesystem and browser tools.
chaining: A computer pauses between agent turns and wakes on the next operation, so a multi-hour task pays only for running seconds; publish_file moves artifacts out to organization-scoped Files that outlive the sandbox.

limits.value: 5,000 free credits (USD 1) at start; vCPU USD 0.000014 per second and memory USD 0.0000045 per GiB-second, with no creation fee
the Standard 7-day trial requires a card and grants 50,000 credits; every route outside billing needs an active plan, and a paused computer resumes only if the balance covers one 10-minute block
12-hour maximum runtime from create to destroy, fixed with no per-computer override; the computer is auto-destroyed at the ceiling

limits_note: A computer you create is billed in advance in 10-minute blocks; a session's computer is billed per running second. The browser is capped at 360 minutes per session. Automatic destroy at zero balance and per-organization concurrency caps are not enforced yet.
binding_note: The USD 1 starting credit runs out first: it buys about 15 hours of a session's 1 vCPU / 1 GiB computer or about 6 hours of the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB default, both shorter than the 12-hour runtime ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: The register page at app.usenaive.ai/register renders an Email field and a terms agreement; the onboarding manifest documents 'naive auth register --email ... --password ...' with a confirmation mail, and states an account starts at 0 credits until a plan is chosen. No card is needed to start free, but the 7-day Standard trial and any paid plan require a card.

reliability_note: Automatic destroy at zero balance and after the maximum runtime is not enforced yet, so a user must delete a computer when finished; cloud metadata, 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 are blocked but 192.168.0.0/16 is not reliably blocked, so private-range blocking is not a security boundary for the shell.
confidence_note: The computer price, egress behaviour and lifecycle are quoted from the vendor's launch post read on 2026-11-25; the free credits, trial card gate and 12-hour ceiling are from the vendor pricing and limits pages on the same date.

notes: naïve sells a hosted disposable Linux microVM ('computer') as part of Naive Managed Agents, either provisioned by a session or created directly through the CLI or SDK. A session computer is 1 vCPU / 1 GiB at USD 0.0666 per running hour; the directly created default 2 vCPU / 4 GiB is USD 0.1656 an hour. Idle between turns costs nothing because the machine sleeps. The account starts with 5,000 free credits and no card; a card is required for the 7-day trial and any paid plan. The 12-hour lifetime cap and unenforced failsafes are the caveats.
